whatIs.title: ☕ What Is a Coffee Massage?
whatIs.p1: The Coffee Massage is a body treatment that combines natural coffee exfoliation, massage, and deep hydration into a unique spa experience.
whatIs.p2: Coffee is one of the most widely used ingredients in body aesthetics due to its antioxidant properties and its ability to stimulate skin circulation and renewal.
whatIs.p3: During the session, natural coffee grounds are applied to gently exfoliate dead skin cells, followed by a relaxing massage that helps release tension and leaves skin feeling soft, smooth, and nourished.
bullets: ✔ Softer, smoother, and more radiant-looking skin
✔ Deep body relaxation and stress release
✔ Deep hydration for dry or tired skin

session.title: 💆‍♀️ What Is a Session Like?
session.intro: Enjoy a step-by-step 60-minute relaxing body ritual

steps.d: We prepare the treatment area and select the appropriate exfoliation protocol for your skin.
Natural coffee grounds and nourishing oils are applied with gentle circular movements to exfoliate and stimulate the skin.
A relaxing massage is performed to ease muscle tension, improve circulation, and promote deep relaxation.
An ultra-nourishing body cream or oil is applied to seal in hydration and leave the skin silky smooth.

cellulite.title: ❓ Does a Coffee Massage Help with Cellulite?
cellulite.p1: While coffee exfoliation and massage can help improve skin texture and stimulate local circulation, it is not a permanent cure for cellulite.
cellulite.p2: However, regular body exfoliation combined with massage can help skin look smoother, firmer, and more toned.
cellulite.p3: If you are looking for targeted cellulite reduction, we also offer specialized aesthetic treatments such as Carboxytherapy and Anti-Cellulite Protocols.
cellulite.p4: Our team will gladly recommend the best treatment for your goals.
